DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 演奏の音に子どもが驚いて泣いています。少し静かな場所へ移りたいのですが、近くに座れる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音に驚いた子どもと近くの静かな休憩席を探していると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The music has startled my child, who is crying. I would like to move somewhere a little quieter. Is there somewhere to sit nearby?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are looking for a quiet seat nearby to rest with your child, who was startled by the sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物の反対側に休憩席があります。ここより音は小さく聞こえますが、完全には止みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are seats for resting on the other side of the building. The sound is quieter there than here, but it does not stop completely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完全に静かでなくても大丈夫です。演奏を止めてほしいという相談ではなく、子どもが落ち着ける場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 演奏中止ではなく子どもが落ち着ける場所を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It does not have to be completely quiet. I am not asking for the performance to stop; I am looking for somewhere my child can settle down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want somewhere your child can settle down, rather than asking for the performance to stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。出口はさらに先ですが、まず休憩席へ向かうほうが近いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. The exit is farther ahead, but it is closer to go to the resting seats first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物も多いので、先に近い席で休みます。子どもを連れて階段を使わず行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出口より近い席で休むため階段のない経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have a lot of things with us too, so we will rest at the nearby seats first. Can I get there with my child without using stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a route without stairs so you can rest at the seats that are closer than the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この建物沿いの平らな通路で行けます。正面の階段を使う必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use this flat path along the building. You do not need to use the stairs in front.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には建物の反対側へ移ると伝えました。落ち着いたら演奏へ戻らず、そのまま帰るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ移動先を連絡し休憩後は帰る予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have told my friend that we are moving to the other side of the building. Once my child settles down, we plan to go straight home without returning to the performance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have told your friend where you are going and plan to go home after resting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りになる際も、その通路を戻って案内板から出口へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you leave, you can go back along that path and head from the information sign to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず建物沿いに休憩席へ行きます。そこで落ち着いてから友人と荷物をまとめ、出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物沿いに休憩席へ移り落ち着いてから友人と出口へ向かうと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will first follow the building to the resting seats. Once my child settles down, my friend and I will gather our things and head to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will follow the building to the resting seats and head for the exit with your friend once your child settles down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞゆっくり移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your time moving there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符の購入でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you buy tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の往復を買いたいのですが、行きも帰りも今日になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の往復券の往路と復路が同日表示になっていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy round-trip tickets for two, but both the outward and return journeys are set to today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the outward and return journeys for two people's round-trip tickets both display the same date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ購入前ですね。帰るのは何日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not bought them yet, have you? What day will you return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行きは今日、帰りは明日です。一泊するので同じ日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日出発して一泊し明日帰ると日付を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: We are going today and coming back tomorrow. We are staying one night, so it is not the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the dates in Japanese, explaining that you leave today, stay one night, and return tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの日付を明日に直しましょう。明日の出発時刻は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us change the return date to tomorrow. Have you decided what time to leave tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宿のチェックアウト後にしたいですが、予約メールを見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宿の退出時刻を予約メールで確認してから帰りの時刻を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We would like to leave after checking out of our accommodation, but we will decide after looking at the reservation email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the accommodation's checkout time in the reservation email before deciding the return departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付だけ先に直し、時刻は確認してから選んでください。人数は二人とも同じ行程ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please correct just the date first and choose the time once you have checked. Will both people follow the same itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、二人とも同じです。明日の午後の便を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人とも同じ行程で翌日午後の便を選ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, we both will. We will choose a service tomorrow afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that both people have the same itinerary and will choose a service the next afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二人、今日の往路と明日の午後の復路ですね。確認画面をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Two people, traveling outward today and returning tomorrow afternoon. Please look at the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宿泊の日付とも合っています。二人分で、帰りが明日になっていることを確認して購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宿泊日付と照合して二人分の翌日復路を確認し購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It matches the dates of our stay too. I will check that it is for two people and that the return is tomorrow before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will compare the accommodation dates, confirm the next-day return for two people, and buy the tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。購入後は人数分の券をお取りください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. After purchasing, please take the tickets for both people. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で税金の相談と伝えましたが、届いた通知を見たら内容が違うようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 税の相談と電話したが実際の通知内容が違うと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I said over the phone that I wanted advice about taxes, but looking at the notice I received, it seems to be about something else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your earlier statement in Japanese: you called about taxes, but the actual notice concerns something different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の件名を見せてください。どの欄で違うと思われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the subject of the notice. Which part made you think it was different?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 給付の申請について追加書類とあります。金額が書いてあったので納付書かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給付の追加書類案内を金額表示から納付書と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says additional documents for a benefit application. There was an amount written on it, so I thought it was a payment notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the request for additional benefit documents for a payment notice because an amount was shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 納付の通知とは別の件ですね。照会番号を使って担当を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it is a different matter from a notice to pay. I will use the reference number to check who is responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この右上の番号です。電話で予約した税の窓口へは行かなくていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 照会番号を示し予約済みの税窓口へ向かうべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is this number at the top right. Do I still need to go to the tax counter where I made an appointment by phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the reference number and ask in Japanese whether you should go to the tax counter where you already have an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先にこちらで担当を照会します。別の担当になる場合は予約先へ訂正を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the responsible department here first. If it is a different department, we will inform the department you booked with of the correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。追加で必要な書類は、ここで意味を説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当照会を頼み追加書類の意味を説明してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Could someone here explain what the additional documents required mean?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the responsible department to be checked and the meaning of the additional documents to be explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から説明します。手元に同じ名前の資料があれば一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain. If you have any documents with the same names, we can check them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄に会社の証明があります。通知と照合して、必要なものか担当に見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の証明を持参しているので通知と照合して担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a certificate from my company in my bag. I will have the person in charge compare it with the notice and check whether it is what is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought a company certificate and will ask the person in charge to compare it with the notice and check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知と資料をお持ちになってこちらでお待ちください。担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the notice and documents with you and wait here. I will pass this on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions for reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 緊急連絡先に母を書きましたが、母は海外にいて日中は電話に出ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外の母を緊急連絡先に記入したが日中は連絡できないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my mother as my emergency contact, but she is overseas and does not answer the phone during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you entered your mother overseas as the emergency contact but cannot reach her during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の連絡先とは別の欄ですね。連絡できる別の方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is a separate field from your own contact details, correct? Is there someone else we can reach?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本にいる兄がいます。ただ、まだ緊急連絡先にする話をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 国内の兄はいるが連絡先にする了承をまだ得ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My older brother is in Japan. However, I have not spoken to him about making him my emergency contact yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your older brother is in Japan but you have not yet received his consent to list him as a contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡先にしてよいか確認できますか。ここではまだお兄様の情報は書かずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check whether he agrees to be listed? Please wait without entering his information here yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 兄に電話して承諾を聞きます。私の番号は先に記入していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄へ了承を確認し本人の番号を先に記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call my brother to ask for his consent. May I fill in my own number first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will ask your brother for consent and ask whether you can enter your own number first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の欄へ記入してください。ご家族の欄と混ぜないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put it in your own field. Let us keep it separate from the family contact field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 兄が了承しました。日中も連絡を受けられると言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄が了承して日中も連絡可能と答えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My brother has agreed. He says he can take calls during the day too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your brother has consented and said he can also be contacted during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では担当に追加方法を確認します。番号の転記もご本人で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will ask the person in charge how to add him. Please check for yourself that the number has been copied correctly too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の欄と兄の欄を分けます。母に代えて兄を連絡先にする方法を担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と家族の欄を分け母から兄へ変える記入方法を担当へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep my field separate from my brother's. I will ask the person in charge how to replace my mother with my brother as the contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will separate your own field from the family field and ask the person in charge how to change the contact from your mother to your brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が取れましたら記入をご案内します。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once we have confirmed the procedure, we will explain how to fill it in. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工事の迂回看板を見ました。歩いて駅へ行く時も、車と同じ道へ回るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工事の車両迂回を徒歩の駅行きにも使うのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a construction detour sign. When walking to the station, do I need to take the same detour as cars?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the vehicle detour for construction also applies when walking to the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看板の写真を見せてください。車両向けか歩行者向けか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me a photo of the sign. Let us check whether it is for vehicles or pedestrians.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。車両迂回とありますが、その言葉が分からず矢印だけ見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真の車両迂回という言葉を理解せず矢印だけ見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It says vehicle detour, but I did not understand those words and only looked at the arrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not understand the words vehicle detour in the photo and only looked at the arrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これは車両向けの表示です。歩道が通れるかは別の案内で確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sign is for vehicles. Whether the sidewalk is open needs to be checked using separate information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車の道を歩くとは決めず、工事の案内係へ歩行者の道を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車両経路を徒歩経路とせず案内係へ歩行者の道を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume I should walk along the vehicle route. I would like to ask the construction guide about the pedestrian route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not want to treat the vehicle route as a walking route and want to ask the guide about the pedestrian route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内係の場所が分からなければ、今いる地点と工事箇所を地図で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you do not know where the guide is, please show your current location and the construction site on a map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この交差点の手前にいました。駅へ行くには工事の横を通る予定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地と予定経路の工事箇所を地図で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was just before this intersection. I was planning to pass alongside the construction to get to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your current location and the construction on your planned route on a map, and explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所を確認しました。歩道の案内状況を確認する先をご案内します。ここで通行可とは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have identified the location. I will direct you to a contact that can check the sidewalk guidance. I cannot confirm here that you can pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 車両用の矢印だけで判断せず、歩道の通行案内を確認してから駅へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車両矢印では判断せず歩道の通行案内確認後に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide based only on the vehicle arrow. I will check the sidewalk access instructions before heading to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not decide based on the vehicle arrow and will move on after checking the sidewalk access instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。こちらが照会に使う場所のメモです。確認してからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Here is a note of the location to use when making the inquiry. Please check before continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。発送で何をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to request about shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 誕生日の二十日に贈物を届けたいです。朝九時までに届くようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 誕生日当日の朝九時までに贈物を届けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want the gift delivered on the twentieth, the recipient's birthday. Can it arrive by nine in the morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the gift can be delivered by nine in the morning on the birthday itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達希望日と到着時刻は別です。日付を指定すれば九時までとなるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The preferred delivery date and arrival time are separate. Specifying the date does not mean it will arrive by nine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十日と書けば朝に届くと思いました。友人は午前中だけ家にいる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望日記入で朝到着と思ったことと受取人の午前在宅予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought writing the twentieth meant it would arrive in the morning. My friend plans to be home only in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought entering a delivery date meant morning arrival and that the recipient plans to be home in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使える取扱いを確認します。受取人が受け取れる日や時間を先に確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what services are available. Can you first check the dates and times when the recipient can receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 贈物の中身は言わず、在宅の予定だけ聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 贈物内容は伏せ受取人へ在宅予定だけ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask only when my friend will be home, without revealing what the gift is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check only the recipient's plans to be home while keeping the gift's contents secret.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。今は到着を確約せず、確認後に方法を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will not guarantee arrival at this point; let us choose a method after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人から、二十日は急に不在になり、前日の夕方ならいると返事が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日不在で前日夕方なら在宅という受取人の返答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend replied that something has come up and they will be out on the twentieth, but will be home the evening before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the recipient replied they will be out on the day but home the previous evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは十九日の希望で取扱いを照会します。希望どおり届けられるかはまだ確認中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will inquire about handling it with a preferred delivery date of the nineteenth. We are still checking whether delivery as requested is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 誕生日当日の朝にこだわらず、前日夕方の希望で相談します。取扱いが分かってから発送を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日朝に固執せず前日夕方の取扱照会後に発送を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not insist on the birthday morning and will ask about delivery the previous evening. I will decide whether to send it after I know what service is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not insist on the birthday morning and will decide on shipping after an inquiry about delivery the previous evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を記録して確認します。少々お待ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record your preference and check. Please wait a moment. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をご確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所変更の翌日に本人確認のメールが来ました。昨日の申請と関係があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更翌日の本人確認メールが申請に関連するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: An identity verification email arrived the day after I changed my address. I would like to know whether it is related to yesterday's application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether an identity verification email arriving the day after your address change is related to your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店頭の受付控えはありますか。メール内のリンクは操作しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the copy from your application at the counter? Have you used the link in the email?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えはこちらです。リンクは開かず、画面だけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店頭控えを提示しメールリンクは開いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the copy. I did not open the link; I just brought the screen showing the email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the counter copy and explain in Japanese that you have not opened the email link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に受付記録を確認します。申請の直後に届いても、そのメールが当行のものとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the processing record first. Even if it arrived immediately after your application, the email is not necessarily from our bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申請内容が書いてあれば本物だと思っていました。メールの案内ではなく窓口で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請内容があるだけで本物と思ったが窓口で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought it must be genuine if it included my application details. I would like to check at the counter rather than following the email's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you assumed the application details meant it was genuine, but want to check at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人を確認したうえで担当が調べます。パスワードなどは画面に出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will investigate after verifying your identity. Please do not display passwords or similar information on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールには番号入力の欄がありますが、そこには何も入力していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メールの番号入力欄にも何も入力していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a field for entering a number in the email, but I have not entered anything there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you have not entered anything in the email's number entry field either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。メールの内容と店頭の状態を分けて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge about the email's contents separately from the status at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付控えとメール画面を見せます。必要な本人確認は担当の正式な案内で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えとメールを示し担当の正式案内で必要な本人確認を進めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the counter copy and the email screen. I will complete any necessary identity verification according to the person in charge's official instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show the copy and email and carry out necessary identity verification under the person in charge's official instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。案内までお掛けになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge. Please take a seat and wait for instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there a problem with a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍のデザートが柔らかくなりました。買わないので冷凍棚へ戻してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柔らかくなった未購入冷凍品を元の棚へ戻してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This frozen dessert has softened. I am not going to buy it, so may I put it back in the freezer section?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may put an unpurchased frozen item that has softened back on its original shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を確認しますので、そのまま店員へお渡しください。かごへ入れたのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please hand it to a staff member as it is so we can check its condition. When did you put it in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 買物を始めたときで、三十分ほど前です。未購入なら元へ戻せると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 約三十分前からかごに入れており未購入なら戻せると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I started shopping, about thirty minutes ago. I thought I could put it back if I had not bought it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it has been in your basket for about thirty minutes and you thought you could return it if it was not yet purchased.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温度が変わった状態なので、そのまま売場へは戻さずこちらで確認します。包装は開けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Because its temperature has changed, we will check it here instead of putting it straight back in the sales area. Have you opened the packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けていません。ほかの冷凍品も二つかごにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装は未開封で別の冷凍品二つもかごにあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I have not. I also have two other frozen items in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the packaging is unopened and there are two other frozen items in your basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つも状態を確認します。安全かどうかをお客様の手で押して判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check those two as well. Please do not press them with your hands to judge whether they are safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部見せます。今日は買う物を決め直し、冷凍品は最後に取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三点を店員へ示し買物を決め直して冷凍品は最後に選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show you all of them. I will reconsider what to buy today and pick up the frozen items last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show all three items to the staff, reconsider your shopping, and choose frozen items last.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の三点はお預かりします。新しく選ぶ物を購入するかは、ご自身でご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take these three items. Please decide for yourself whether you want to buy any newly selected items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 柔らかくなった一つとほかの二つを渡します。自分で棚に戻さず、確認は店にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三点を渡して自分で棚へ戻さず状態判断を店へ任せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the one that has softened and the other two. I will not put them back myself; I will leave checking their condition to the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will hand over all three without returning them to the shelf yourself and leave the condition assessment to the store.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を知らせていただきありがとうございます。こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us about their condition. We will take them here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園でお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あの空いた芝生に荷物を置きましたが、係の人が机を運んでいます。ここは使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物を置いた空き芝生で机の準備が始まり利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my things on that empty lawn, but staff are carrying tables there. May we use that area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can use the apparently empty lawn where you put your things, as preparations with tables have begun.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あちらは団体の予約区画です。利用者が来る前に準備しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That area is reserved for a group. They are preparing before the users arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 誰も座っていなかったので空いていると思いました。すぐ荷物を移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無人なので空いていると思ったが予約区画から荷物を移すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was available because nobody was sitting there. I will move our things right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the reserved area was available because no one was there, but will move your things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一般利用の場所は、白い線のこちら側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The area for general use is on this side of the white line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらで家族と昼食を取ります。ベビーカーも一緒に置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一般区画で昼食を取りベビーカーも置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will have lunch with our family here. Can we put our stroller here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can have lunch in the general-use area and put a stroller there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路と区画の入口を空ければ置けます。予約区画の搬入経路にも掛からないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can if you keep the path and the area's entrance clear. Please also keep clear of the route for bringing supplies into the reserved area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 線から離れた所へ寄せます。机がなくても敷物の上で食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 搬入経路と通路を空け線から離れて敷物で過ごすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move it away from the line. We will eat on our mat even if there is no table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the delivery route and path clear and spend time on a mat away from the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食後のごみは持ち帰ってください。団体用の箱は利用者専用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your rubbish home after eating. The group's bins are for its users only.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を一般区画へ移して通路を空け、ごみは持ち帰ります。団体の箱は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を移しごみを持ち帰り団体専用箱は使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move our things to the general-use area, keep the path clear, and take our rubbish home. We will not use the group's bins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will move your things, take your rubbish home, and not use the bins reserved for the group.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。どうぞゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 楽器のケースが改札に引っ掛かりそうです。縦にして通してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い楽器ケースを縦にして改札へ通してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My instrument case looks as though it might get caught in the ticket gate. May I turn it upright to pass through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may turn a long instrument case upright to take it through the ticket gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に通さず、長さと中身を教えてください。券も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not force it through. Tell me its length and contents. We will check your ticket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長さは一メートル半です。中身は楽器で、券はこの携帯にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケースの長さと楽器という中身を伝え携帯の券を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is one and a half meters long. There is a musical instrument inside, and my ticket is on this phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the case's length and that it contains a musical instrument, and show the ticket on your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扱える荷物か係員が確認します。横の広い入口は、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check whether we can accommodate this baggage. After checking, we will direct you to the wide entrance at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知らない人に先に渡してもらおうと思いましたが、自分の手元で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人へ荷物を先渡しせず自分で保持して確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to ask a stranger to take it through ahead of me, but I will keep it with me and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not pass the baggage ahead to someone else and will keep it with you while waiting for the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま安全な位置でお持ちください。ここでは人の流れを避けて待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep hold of it in a safe position. You can wait here out of the flow of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 床へ置くと通路を塞ぐので、壁側で持って待ちます。発車まであまり時間がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を塞がない壁側で待つが発車まで時間が少ないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Putting it on the floor would block the path, so I will hold it by the wall while waiting. There is not much time before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait beside the wall without blocking the path but there is little time before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車に間に合わない場合の券の扱いも確認します。入口を急いで通る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check what happens to your ticket if you miss the departure. There is no need to rush through the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ケースと携帯の券を係員に見せます。通れると確認されてから案内された入口を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物と券の確認後に係員指定の入口を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the case and the ticket on my phone to the staff member. Once they confirm I can pass, I will use the entrance they indicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use the entrance indicated by staff after the baggage and ticket have been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 係員を呼びました。こちらでお待ちください。確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have called a staff member. Please wait here. We will guide you after checking.
